questions.question: Count the number of high schoolers.
Show the names of all high schoolers in grade 10.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade  =  10

questions.question: What are the names of all high schoolers in grade 10?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade  =  10

questions.question: Show me all grades that have at least 4 students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING count(*)  >=  4

questions.question: Return the name of the high school student with the most friends.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have 3 or more friends?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  3

questions.question: Show the names of all of the high schooler Kyle's friends.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T1.friend_id  =  T3.id WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"

questions.question: Show names of all high school students who do not have any friends.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id

questions.question: What are the ids of students who both have friends and are liked?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT student_id FROM Friend INTERSECT SELECT liked_id FROM Likes

questions.question: Show the names of high schoolers who have likes, and numbers of likes for each.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id

questions.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have likes, and how many likes does each have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id

questions.question: What is the name of the high schooler who has the greatest number of likes?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 5 and have at least 2 friends.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.grade  >  5 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: What is the lowest grade of students who do not have any friends?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT min(grade) FROM Highschooler WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT T1.student_id FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id)
